title: Organic Cheese Cloths, GOTS Certified, 6PCS, Grade 100, 20x20Inch Hemmed Cheese Cloth Fabric Reusable Fine Mesh Cloth, 100% Cotton Unbleached Muslin Cheesecloth for Straining, Cooking, Yogurt, Juicing
description:
GOTS Certified. Made from 100% organic cotton, no odor, no GMOs, no highly hazardous chemicals, and no child labor.
20x20Inch Pre-cut Suitable Size - No need to cut manually. Well Hemmed & No Shed Lint - Prevent small threads drop in the food. Easy Clean - Reused many times with a simple rinse, finally worn it out, then compost it.
SGS Tested Grade 100 - Our woven fabrics is 56x41. Didn't reduce threads. No Easy to Tear - The higher threads per square inch, the higher cost. You got what you pay.
Truly Chemical Free - Strain broth, baste turkey, make jams and fruit jelly, all without plastic. Unbleached Organic Cotton - Strain soy milk, cold brew coffee, juice, and any other foods without worrying.
FSC Certified. Packed with biodegradable packaging to fulfill the promise of being truly plastic-free! Good for the environment and be beneficial to your family's health. You can strain the food with confidence.
reviews_5s:
I love these SO MUCH. These are the ones I will order from now on. I know these are designed for food use, but I actually use them for gentle cleansing for my really sensitive skin. Ever since my skin allergies went crazy, organic cotton is all that I can use. In the shower, these cleanse really well without scrubbing or irritating skin. The hems look well-made and I've noticed no fraying or tearing. They're a generous size. My favorite part is how gentle they are on my face. A tiny bit of exfoliation, just enough... Doesn't cause a rash but still refreshes my skin when I use a mild astringent like green tea. I also use it to pat my hands dry, because other organic cloths have been too scratchy and given me rashes. What would I do without these... 🥹💓What does this cheesecloth have to do? Just keep my chicken bones in one place while I make it into stock. I don't taste any difference using these, so no added flavor from the cotton. These remind me of my mom's. Simple cloth. I like that it's made from 100% cotton, so no microplastic leeching into my food. They're large enough for 3 sets of chicken bones left over from Costco roasters. I tie the opposing corners, so I don't use metal clips or string to close it up. I hand wash them with dish soap. I'm happy with these.Exactly what I wanted. So far happy with it.Perfect for bone broth! Easy size to strain in one gallon glass jars or smaller.Definitely worth the price especially since you can use it for so many things!
